body.condition: There exist disjoint row sets \(S_1,S_2\) and orders \(\rho_1,\rho_2\) such that \(\Gamma_{s(a,k),\rho_a(k)}=1\) and \(\Gamma_{s(a,k),\rho_a(\ell)}=0\) for every \(a\in\{1,2\}\), \(k\in\{1,\ldots,K\}\), and \(\ell>k\).

novel.justification: This is a categorical graph condition: it permits each selected item to depend on its diagonal latent state and arbitrary earlier categorical states, so it is not inherited from a binary scalar-contrast theorem. Polytomous skill batteries with two ordered prerequisite-sensitive item blocks satisfy it even when no block is pure; the eight-row ternary graph \(\Gamma^{\star}\) is an explicit dense example.
